comments.author: ArkanExplorer
comments.story: Boston Dynamics unveils Stretch, a robot designed to move boxes in warehouses
comments.text: Here's the video Boston Dynamics released, showing the robot in action: [VIDEO] As far as I can see, boxes are picked up from one side, or the top. Some boxes would collapse due to this uneven distribution of force - a human worker would normally pick up a box from both sides, or the bottom.
